verses.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.text: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
He saith: Will ye look?
Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.text: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
Are we then not to die

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.text: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
For the like of this, then, let the workers work.

verses.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.text: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.text: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.text: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.text: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
They indeed found their fathers astray,
But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
And verily We sent among them warners.
Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
And made his seed the survivors,
And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
Lo! thus do We reward the good.
Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
Then We did drown the others.
And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.text: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
And he glanced a glance at the stars
Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
And they turned their backs and went away from him.

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.text: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
What aileth you that ye speak not?
Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.text: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.text: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
